adoration.text: Adoration Room: Weekdays 07:00–22:00; weekends 07:00–20:00; public holidays 09:00–17:00; closed on Mondays 09:00–14:00 for cleaning (1st Mondays 09:00–16:00).

confession.text: Confession is available 30 minutes before all weekend Masses when a priest is available.

devotions.text: Rosary is said 40 minutes before weekday evening Masses and weekend Masses.
Divine Mercy Devotion every Thursday at 20:00 in L3 Auditorium.
Intercessory every Tuesday at 20:00 in L3 Room 3.4.
Chinese Prayer Group every Friday at 20:00 in L4 Room 4.2.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Thursday at 20:00 in Church Hall.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Friday at 20:00 in Church Hall.

good_to_know.text: Weekday morning Mass includes Saturday mornings.
Rosary is said after public holiday Mass.
